title: Add hero video background, default dark theme, cookie consent banner, and customer ratings

requirements.text: Add an animated short laptop/motherboard repairing video as the Home page Hero background, rendered behind the existing Hero content with a readable overlay. The video must autoplay (muted), loop, and play inline on mobile, and it must gracefully fall back (e.g., to the existing hero background image) if the video cannot be loaded.

quotes: animated laptop motherboard repairing short video for home page background

acceptanceCriteria: A new video file exists under `frontend/public/assets/generated/` and is used by `frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSection.tsx` as the hero background.
Hero foreground content (headline, subheadline, buttons, stats) remains readable due to an overlay layer (e.g., gradient/tint) above the video.
The video is configured for background playback: `autoplay`, `muted`, `loop`, and `playsInline`.
If the video fails to load, the Hero shows a non-broken background (fallback to an image/color) without layout shifts.

requirements.text: Switch the site to use a dark theme by default across the marketing pages (Home sections) and Admin view, ensuring text, borders, cards, and CTAs have sufficient contrast and the overall look is consistently dark.
acceptanceCriteria: On first load, the app renders in dark mode by default (the `dark` class is applied at the document level, e.g., via `frontend/index.html`).

All main sections (Header, Hero, Services, About, Contact, Footer) render with dark backgrounds and readable text using existing theme tokens in `frontend/src/index.css` (no unreadable low-contrast areas).
Admin view (`/#/admin`) also renders correctly in dark mode with readable tables, inputs, and cards.

requirements.text: Add a cookie consent/notice banner that appears on the site until the user accepts (and optionally declines). Persist the choice locally so the banner does not reappear on subsequent visits, and include clear English user-facing text.
acceptanceCriteria: A cookie notice banner is visible on the Home view until the user makes a choice.
The banner includes at minimum an “Accept” action; after accepting, the banner is dismissed and does not reappear on refresh (preference persisted in `localStorage` or equivalent).
Banner text is in English and clearly indicates that the site uses cookies/local storage for basic functionality.
The banner is accessible (keyboard reachable actions, visible focus state) and does not block critical navigation once dismissed.

requirements.text: Add a public website rating feature for Legend Techno Solutions so visitors can submit a rating (e.g., 1–5 stars) and an optional comment, and display recent ratings on the marketing site near the end of the Home page (after the Contact section).

quotes: in last page add rating website for legend

acceptanceCriteria: Backend: a new public method exists to create a rating with fields for rating value and optional comment, and it stores a timestamp; ratings persist across upgrades (add `backend/migration.mo` only if required by the platform’s upgrade policy).
Backend: a query method exists to list ratings (for rendering on the public site), with most-recent-first ordering.
Frontend: a new “Ratings” section exists near the end of the Home page and includes a simple form to submit a rating and a list/summary of recent ratings.
On successful submission, the new rating appears in the ratings list without requiring a full page reload (React Query invalidation/refetch).
Validation prevents out-of-range ratings (only 1–5 allowed) and shows clear English error messages for invalid input or failed submission.

requirements.text: Extend the Admin dashboard to allow viewing submitted website ratings in a simple table/list (most recent first) so the business can review feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin view (`frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx`) includes an additional section for Ratings with a table/list showing rating value, comment (if any), and timestamp.
If there are no ratings, the UI shows an English empty-state message (e.g., “No ratings yet”).

constraints: Do not edit files in `frontend/src/components/ui` or any paths listed under `frontend.immutablePaths` in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo`; add `backend/migration.mo` only if needed for state upgrades.
Do not introduce external databases, third-party auth, web sockets, or external email/cookie services.
nonGoals: Sending email notifications when a user submits a contact form or rating (no email integration).
Integrating third-party cookie consent management platforms.
Adding social login providers other than Internet Identity.

required: Short looping laptop/motherboard repair video clip (legend-techno-hero-bg-video.dim_1600x900.mp4)
